newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair cargo traffic up six pct Jan-Sept 96.
newsitem.headline: Swissair cargo traffic up six pct Jan-Sept 96.

text.p: Swissair said cargo shipments transported in the first nine months of 1996 totalled 1.2 billion freight tonne kilometres (FTK), up six percent on the same period last year.

Swissair's ex-Switzerland-Far East cargo routes (excluding Japan) achieved the biggest growth of the airline's seven cargo traffic regions, up 23 percent on January-September 1995 at 377.9 million FTK, company figures showed.
For Swissair, this region includes destinations such as Bangkok, Singapore, Hong Kong, Beijing, Shangai, Seoul and Manilla, as well as destinations in India and Pakistan.
Cargo volume transported by the Swiss airline between Switzerland and Japan fell by eight percent on the first nine months of 1995 to 82.7 million FTK.

Swissair's North American routes showed three percent growth on the same period last year to 492.2 million FTK while South America tabled an increase of 22 percent on the same period last year to 40.4 million FTK.
European traffic declined by 11 percent on January-September 1995 at 43.9 million FTK, the carrier said.
